backend_assumptions.generic_cost: Plane formation is charged as one vector operation per value in a 512-value Slice. Multicast is charged as one vector unit per BF16 value. Prefetch and compute are serial on the generic path.
backend_assumptions.scope: Matched compute, buffer and HBM settings. Generic service mapping is a modeled proxy, not a GPU timing run.
backend_assumptions.utilization: The 51.83% and 86.83% representative Slice utilization values are transferred to sparse issue stages; they are not measured trajectory averages.

reference_evidence: Historical numerical anchors. 34 of 42 workbook rows match the local synthetic-simulated experiment tables at the same model and normalized speedup.
